Verbal battery: tasks like "list all the ways you could improve a toy so children would have more fun with it" or "ask as many questions as you can about this picture"

Setup: 256 human participants were compared against three AI chatbots (ChatGPT-3, ChatGPT-4, and Copy.ai) using the alternate uses task, generating uncommon and creative uses for everyday objects. The specific objects tested were a rope, a box, a pencil, and a candle.
